ai_review.summary: Decent performance hampered by an over‑aggressive Dolby mix that dulls the highs
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the show itself as very good, but notes that the recording suffers because the Dolby processing is too heavy and mutes much of the high end. The result is a listening experience that feels muffled despite the underlying quality of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review with a zero‑star rating focusing on recording issues; no concrete information about the musical performance, so the overall score leans low but cannot be assessed confidently.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Dolby processing is applied heavily, swallowing high frequencies and making the mix sound muffled.
